fit_reason: Whole 15-foot sailboat with trailer listed by a private seller; fiberglass hull and deck we can clean and polish.
findings: Dirt and grime staining across the cockpit floor around the inspection port
Dusty, dull off-white deck and side decks, with smudges on the foredeck
Dull, chalky-looking gelcoat on the starboard hull side below the stripes
Clutter of loose lines and rigging piled in the cockpit
Faded wood trim on the thwart and centerboard trunk area
message: Hi, we saw your listing for the Designers Choice sailboat. The cockpit floor has some ground-in grime and the deck and hull look dusty and a bit dull from storage. We do pre-sale cleanups and gelcoat polishing and can come to you. Would you like a quote?
